description.narrative: The project will upgrade and climate-proof 105 kilometers (km) of the national road between the capital, Dili, and the second-largest town, Baucau, which is located on the north coast. The government has requested the Asian Development Bank (ADB) to cofinance the proposed project on a parallel basis with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA). ADB will support upgrading and climate-proofing 56 km of the road connecting the towns of Manatuto and Baucau, and JICA will support the section between Dili and Manatuto (49 km).

description.narrative: More reliable and safer road network

By the end of 2020, travel time on the road between Dili and Baucau decreases by 30% (2016 baseline: 3 hours) Progress/Status: The civil works completed in May 2021. The impact on travel time to be assessed. Data Source: Project completion report prepared by MPW Actual value:

Rate of road accidents on project roads does not increase (crashes resulting in serious injury or loss of life per year) Progress/Status: To be assessed Data Source: National accident statistics produced by the Timor-Leste National Police Force Base year: 2020 Baseline value: Y
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Performance-based road maintenance expanded Indicator: By the end of 2020, performance-based maintenance for the upgraded 105 km section of national road executed (2015 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: PMB is in progress to meet the target by August 2024 Data Source: Annual road condition surveys by DRBFC; DRBFC road maintenance program annual reports Actual value: Y

Output: 105 km of national road between Dili and Baucau upgraded and climate-proofed Indicator: By the end of 2020, the average roughness of the 105 km section of national road between Dili and Baucau decreases to less than 4 m/km baseline: average of 8 m/km (2016) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Civil work for ADB portion of 57.6 km has achieved 95% Remaining of 49 km of JICA portion has also well progressed and has achieved 90%. Data Source: Annual road condition surveys by DRBFC; project monitoring reports from MPWTC Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Awareness of road safety and transport-related social issues generated Indicator: By the end of 2020, at least 80% of children and 80% of women in project roadside communities receive road safety awareness education. (baseline: not applicable) Progress/Status: Conducted during implementation of the project Data Source: Records of road safety education delivered to schools maintained by the Ministry of Education Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Awareness of road safety and transport-related social issues generated Indicator: Rate of increase of fatal injury due to road crash on the project road is less than the rate of growth in the national vehicle fleet Progress/Status: Regularly received report from consultant report. the accurate data to be assessed during PCR Data Source: Records of crash fatalities maintained by the Road Safety Directorate, Ministry of the Interior, Timor-Leste National Police Force, and Ministry of Health Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y
